data.name: SidebarDescription
data.value: A miniature shell to try every combination of placement, rendering, opening and collapse of the side menu, without touching the menu of this site.

data.name: SidebarSettingsDescription
data.value: Its own menu, independent from the site: change a setting and watch the preview.

data.name: SidebarTransitionDescription
data.value: How the pushed menu opens and closes: at once, or sliding.

data.name: SidebarBackdropDescription
data.value: An overlaid menu dims the rest of the preview; a click on the veil closes it.

data.name: WindowControlsDescription
data.value: The caption buttons of a borderless desktop window, square and full height in the header; a button is drawn only when its callback is set.

data.name: WindowControlsSettingsDescription
data.value: Each switch sets or clears the callback of one button.

data.name: WindowControlsTrayDescription
data.value: Hides the window in the notification area.

data.name: WindowControlsMinimizeDescription
data.value: Sends the window to the taskbar.

data.name: WindowControlsMaximizeDescription
data.value: Its icon follows Maximized, which the example switches at each click.

data.name: WindowControlsCloseDescription
data.value: In the very corner, red on hover.

data.name: WindowControlsActionsDescription
data.value: A button placed before them through ActionsContent.

data.name: LoadingBarDescription
data.value: A bar under the header that announces a load. It follows the loading state of the application and takes no room of its own.

data.name: LoadingBarSettingsDescription
data.value: It takes no room: during a load it is laid over the bottom edge of the header, shifting nothing and leaving no gap.

data.name: LoadingBarModeDescription
data.value: A sweep across, or a fill that slows down without finishing while the load lasts, then completes.

data.name: LoadingBarColorDescription
data.value: The bar colour. It is the --omni-loading-bar-color variable, declared on the bar itself and redefined here by a class set on the bar.

data.name: LoadingBarPreviewHint
data.value: A bar under a header, fed by the loading state: start a load for three, five or ten seconds, the length of a real load not being known in advance.

data.name: NotificationsDescription
data.value: The notification stack: placement, countdown, close button and grouping, then the card itself for each role.

data.name: NotificationsSettingsDescription
data.value: Placement, countdown, dismissal and grouping of the stack. They hold for the stack of this page only.

data.name: NotificationsPlacementDescription
data.value: The corner or edge the stack grows from.

data.name: NotificationsCountdownDescription
data.value: The card takes the tint of its role, which drains over the time it has left.

data.name: NotificationsDismissibleDescription
data.value: A cross to send the notification away without waiting.

data.name: NotificationsGroupDescription
data.value: Several notifications stack behind a count, and fan out on hover.

data.name: NotificationsStackHint
data.value: Three text lengths, a 4,000-character report, the four roles, an action and a burst to judge the grouping. The notifications appear in the stack of the host, at the corner chosen in the settings.

data.name: NotificationsCardsHint
data.value: The card placed by hand in the page: one per role and one with an action. A cross hides its card.

data.name: TooltipsDescription
data.value: A tooltip appears after its delay, then follows the pointer or stays where it opened.

data.name: TooltipsSettingsDescription
data.value: Where a tooltip sits and how long it waits. The settings apply to the first preview below.

data.name: TooltipsTrackingDescription
data.value: Follow the pointer, or stay where it appeared.

data.name: TooltipsWidthDescription
data.value: Beyond it the text wraps; it is never cut.

data.name: TooltipsDelayDescription
data.value: How long the pointer rests before the tooltip shows, from 0 to 2 seconds in steps of 100 ms. 300 ms by default.

data.name: TooltipsVariantsHint
data.value: On a badge: by default, pinned, narrow, and wide with a long text that opens on a preview and unfolds on request.

data.name: TooltipsTitleAttributeHint
data.value: Placed once in a layout, OmniTitleTooltips replaces the browser tooltip of every title attribute with the one of the package.
